patchNotes: See docs/P4-REVIEW.md and docs/P4-R2.md. Architect token boundary applies injected network policy and removes raw server/network details while preserving cancellation and wire fields. Hashes record provenance, not protocol/runtime acceptance. P4-B adds bounded callback-terminal foreground HTTP/file I/O, same-token OpenID subject verification, Retry-After propagation and adapter-verified single-pass preparation. Original/non-quota commit/device/quality fields, hash query and native-pair metadata remain pinned. See docs/P4-B-INTEGRATION.md. P5/P6 disallow constrained networks consistently with the shared Low Data gate. Source pin unchanged; adapted-file digest refreshed. See docs/P5-P6-INTEGRATION.md. P8-R1 adapts the same pinned upstream isolated browser sign-in in Settings: strict cookie domain, foreground/deadline-bounded observer supplementation, sanitized failures and teardown. No source-pin or upload-protocol change; device login remains unverified. See docs/P8-FIRST-RUN.md. P9 adds closed diagnostic stages, safe transport/HTTP codes and app-owned ephemeral credential exchange sessions. Source revision and upload wire fields unchanged; updated adapted digests are source evidence only. See docs/P9-DIAGNOSTICS.md. P9-R2 separates JSON identity headers, reuses the freshly redeemed unbound token, and records closed authentication rejection names/stages. Upload wire fields and source pin unchanged; device acceptance pending. See docs/P9-R2.md. P9-R3 compares pinned PhotosBackup sign-in and adds same-token POST/Bearer tokeninfo fallback, bounded identity proof caching/reverification and removes raw provider error prose. Source pin and original/non-quota upload wire fields unchanged. See docs/P9-R3.md. P38 verifies adapted-file drift against committed source history; The sole GPMC change since the prior recorded digest (0401947 to 5157532) reuses app-owned foreground API connections while retaining bounded requests and shutdown. CI now rejects adapted-file hash drift. Exact upstream source pin unchanged; adapted digests are source evidence, not service acceptance. P44 adds bounded OS task submission using the existing authenticated file PUT request. Initialization, authentication, receipt validation, original-quality/nonquota commit and pairing fields remain unchanged. Upstream commit/source digest unchanged; adapted digest records reviewed local transport changes only. P47: encode bounded signed Unix seconds and fractional nanoseconds for commit metadata; preserve pre-1970 dates without changing media bytes or source pin. P53: retain upload/commit profile and add read-only library metadata calls with bounded timeout. Invalid UTF8 is a malformed response rather than a negative hash match. Source pins unchanged. P54: record current-request commit dispatch before HTTP task resume; preserve unsent proof through session errors and never clear legacy uncertainty. Add bounded safe metadata parser/response-limit reasons; no quota/quality/device fields, source pins or response/storage limits changed. P55: retain exact upstream pins and original/nonquota commit fields; isolate metadata response budget to 4 MiB and page records to 5000. Adapter resumes completed receipts only after exact checks and reader settlement, with persisted finalization attempts and verified-key-only confirmation. P56: retain safe structured HTTP status, canonical RPC code and response size/shape for job-correlated errors. No raw response or credential text is exported; exact source pin and original/nonquota wire remain unchanged. Reject malformed, empty or oversized finalization keys explicitly; accepted field paths remain unchanged. Parse canonical Google status in structured JSON errors as well as protobuf; raw server messages remain unexported. P57: empty finalization responses explicitly retain empty response shape; original upload/profile fields and pin unchanged. P61/R1: coalesce bounded same-client token refresh, preserve HTTP service/rate failure classification before Android auth rejection, and assert final PUT endpoint. No upstream revision, original/nonquota profile, hash/receipt wire or login-protocol change. P61/R3: terminal PUT401 verifies refreshed account before reporting a retryable file failure; does not resend bytes or relax receipt/native-reader gates.
